verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents Docker Compose as its recommended install path, with npm and Helm alternatives. Its Quick Start is described as "about five minutes with Docker" and serves the app at localhost:3080 on Windows, macOS, or Linux. A hands-on community user also called the install "quite easy". Missing for 10: the literal single command isn't shown in the evidence, and the pack doesn't show whether setup (env/override files, provider API keys) is needed before a working chat.
